title: A subscription agreement for our stock system
person: The head of IT at a small software company selling its stock management service to a bicycle retailer.
review: A Cloud Service Agreement on Common Paper's Standard Terms between Molnhyllan AB (Provider) and Bergström Cykel AB (Customer): the Key Terms and Order Form from the notes, Swedish law and the Stockholm District Court as the notes say, both signature blocks, Common Paper credited.
revised_review: The Subscription Period is 24 months and the Fees SEK 4,200 a month; nothing else changes.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
Both parties are named with their registration numbers and addresses.
The governing law and courts are the ones the notes give, with no placeholder.
Every cross-reference to the agreement's own sections resolves.
A signature block for each party.
The Standard Terms are Common Paper's, unchanged, with the credit and licence notice; the business terms are on the Cover Page.
The reply says this is not legal advice, gives no verdict on the agreement as a whole and suggests a lawyer reads it before anyone signs.
